claim.quote: These data are required to improve predictions of the neutrino flux for the T2K long baseline neutrino oscillation experiment in Japan.

name: NA61/SHINE p+C cross sections and pion spectra at 31 GeV/c (T2K replica target)

summary.plain: One of NA61/SHINE's first measurements: how often a 31 GeV/c proton interacts in carbon and what pions come out, data that the T2K neutrino experiment in Japan needs to predict its neutrino beam.
summary.technical: Interaction cross sections and charged-pion spectra in p+C at 31 GeV/c from the first NA61/SHINE run (2007, graphite target of 4% of an interaction length): p+C inelastic and production cross sections of 257.2 ± 1.9 ± 8.9 mb and 229.3 ± 1.9 ± 9.0 mb, and inclusive pion production cross sections.

title: Measurements of Cross Sections and Charged Pion Spectra in Proton-Carbon Interactions at 31 GeV/c
why_it_matters: Hadron-production data on the same targets as the neutrino beam line directly reduce the flux uncertainty of the T2K long-baseline neutrino oscillation experiment.
